name: staggered-avatar-fan
title: Staggered Avatar Fan
description: A compact deck of overlapping user avatars that fans out radially on hover with proportional rotational offsets.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Hover Radial Spread: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
